controls.title: Third-party actions are pinned to commit SHAs
controls.description: Tags and branches are mutable; a compromised upstream can repoint them at any time.
controls.remediation: Pin every `uses:` entry to a 40-character commit SHA and refresh pins deliberately.

controls.title: Privileged workflow triggers are constrained
controls.description: `pull_request_target` and other privileged events run with repository secrets available.
controls.remediation: Use `pull_request` for untrusted code and document any privileged trigger.

controls.title: Secrets never reach shell output
controls.description: Secret interpolation into `run:` steps and event-data injection both expose credentials.
controls.remediation: Pass secrets and event data through environment variables and quote them.

controls.title: No unverified remote scripts
controls.description: `curl | bash` executes whatever the network returns at build time.
controls.remediation: Download an artefact, verify its digest or signature, then execute it.

controls.title: Container images are immutable
controls.description: Floating tags make builds non-reproducible and hide upstream changes.

controls.title: Workflow tokens follow least privilege
controls.description: A `write-all` token turns any injected step into a repository takeover.

controls.title: No hard-coded credentials in tracked files
controls.description: Credential-shaped literals in a repository are compromised the moment the repo is cloned.
controls.remediation: Revoke the credential, rotate it, and load the replacement from a secret store at runtime.

controls.title: Dependencies are pinned
controls.description: Unpinned requirements resolve differently on every build.
controls.remediation: Pin exact versions and commit the lockfile.

controls.title: No known-vulnerable dependency versions
controls.description: The offline advisory catalogue flags versions below a published fix.
controls.remediation: Upgrade to the fixed version named in the finding and re-run the scan.

controls.title: Pipeline definitions parse
controls.description: An unparseable workflow cannot be evaluated for any other control.
controls.remediation: Fix the YAML syntax before merging.

findings.title: Prototype pollution
findings.message: minimist 1.2.0 is below the fixed version 1.2.6 (CVE-2021-44906): minimist is vulnerable to prototype pollution through crafted arguments..
findings.remediation: Upgrade minimist to 1.2.6 or later.

findings.title: Arbitrary code execution through full_load
findings.message: pyyaml 5.3.1 is below the fixed version 5.4 (CVE-2020-14343): PyYAML's full_load resolves arbitrary Python objects from untrusted documents..
findings.remediation: Upgrade PyYAML to 5.4 or later and parse untrusted input with safe_load.

findings.title: pull_request_target with untrusted checkout
findings.message: The privileged pull_request_target trigger is combined with a checkout of PR head code.
findings.remediation: Run untrusted code under 'pull_request'; keep pull_request_target for label-only workflows.

findings.title: Script injection through event context
findings.message: Untrusted event data (${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}) is interpolated directly into a run step.
findings.remediation: Move the value into an environment variable and reference it as "$VAR".

findings.title: CI job token printed
findings.message: CI_JOB_TOKEN is echoed, exposing it to anyone who can read job logs.
findings.remediation: Remove the echo and mark the variable masked in the project settings.

findings.title: Hard-coded credential assignment
findings.message: Assignment to 'AUTH_TOKEN' carries a high-entropy literal (sha256:0aa5fa9fabfd); value redacted.
findings.remediation: Move the value into a CI secret and reference it by name at runtime.

findings.title: Hard-coded credential assignment
findings.message: Assignment to 'PASSWORD' carries a high-entropy literal (sha256:f6cca2e65989); value redacted.
findings.remediation: Move the value into a CI secret and reference it by name at runtime.

findings.title: Command injection in template
findings.message: lodash 4.17.15 is below the fixed version 4.17.21 (GHSA-35jh-r3h4-6jhm): lodash template allows code injection through crafted template options..
findings.remediation: Upgrade lodash to 4.17.21 or later.

findings.title: Proxy-Authorization header leak on redirect
findings.message: requests 2.28.0 is below the fixed version 2.31.0 (CVE-2023-32681): requests forwards Proxy-Authorization to a redirected destination over HTTPS..
findings.remediation: Upgrade requests to 2.31.0 or later.

findings.title: Request body not stripped on cross-origin redirect
findings.message: urllib3 2.0.6 is below the fixed version 2.0.7 (CVE-2023-45803): urllib3 can forward a request body to a redirected host when a 303 response is returned..
findings.remediation: Upgrade urllib3 to 2.0.7 or later.

findings.title: Unpinned third-party action
findings.message: Action 'actions/checkout@v4' is referenced by tag or branch, not a commit SHA.
findings.remediation: Pin the action to a full 40-character commit SHA; refresh it deliberately.

findings.title: Unpinned third-party action
findings.message: Action 'example-org/third-party-action@main' is referenced by tag or branch, not a commit SHA.
findings.remediation: Pin the action to a full 40-character commit SHA; refresh it deliberately.

findings.title: Secret interpolated into shell output
findings.message: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }} is expanded into a shell command that can print it.
findings.remediation: Pass secrets as environment variables and never echo them; mask them in logs.

findings.title: Floating container image
findings.message: Image 'python:latest' is not pinned to an immutable digest.
findings.remediation: Pin the image by digest (@sha256:…) so a rebuild cannot introduce a new base.

findings.title: Remote script piped into a shell
findings.message: A network download is executed by a shell without integrity verification.
findings.remediation: Verify a checksum or signature before executing downloaded scripts.

findings.title: Commit metadata interpolated into a script
findings.message: Untrusted commit metadata (${CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE}) is expanded into a shell command.
findings.remediation: Quote the value or read it from a file instead of interpolating it into script lines.

findings.title: Unpinned npm dependency
findings.message: left-pad uses '*', which can resolve to a different build on every install.
findings.remediation: Pin left-pad to an exact version; commit the lockfile.

findings.title: Unpinned dependency
findings.message: flask is declared without an exact pin, so builds are not reproducible.
findings.remediation: Pin flask to a reviewed version (==x.y.z) and update it deliberately.

findings.title: Workflow grants write-all permissions
findings.message: The workflow token can write every scope, so any injected step inherits that power.
findings.remediation: Declare the minimal permissions per job, starting from 'contents: read'.

findings.title: Remote script piped into a shell
findings.message: A network download is executed by a shell without integrity verification.
findings.remediation: Download, verify a checksum or signature, then execute the pinned artefact.

findings.title: Unreviewed workflow trigger
findings.message: Trigger(s) outside the approved baseline: pull_request_target.
findings.remediation: Confirm the trigger is required; document the threat model for privileged events.
